result: Default No retained all twelve sources under fresh handles and erase Yes replaced them under stable handles. Coordinates, radii, angles, ellipse axes, spline fit points, bulge, text/MTEXT attachment behavior, dimension measurement, hatch area, styles and block insertion/rotation/negative-X scale/bounds matched; the 45-degree probes, one-command Undo, locked object and refused coincident target all passed, and the owned acad.exe process was terminated.
